Class ServerManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.ServerManager
public class ServerManager extends Object
Coordinates lobby creation, player rejoin, and the lifecycle of active games.

Threading model: lobby state (pendingGames, pendingViews, viewRegistry) is mutated only on the single lobby thread (via submitToLobby(Runnable)); each game's state is mutated only on its own queue (via GameSession.trySubmit(Runnable)). No synchronized is needed: mutual exclusion comes from the queues, and the concurrent maps only serve the pinger's read-only traversal.

  • Method Details

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Releases every resource owned by the manager: stops the heartbeat pinger, shuts down the lobby and countdown executors, and drains each active game's command queue. Save files are deliberately left untouched so the games can be restored on the next start. Idempotent on the executors.

    • generateUniqueLobbyId

      private String generateUniqueLobbyId()
      Generates a unique 6-digit code, verifying that there are no collisions.

    • submitToLobby

      public void submitToLobby(Runnable task)
      Enqueues a lobby operation on the single lobby thread. Exceptions are logged instead of silently disappearing inside the executor's Future.
      Parameters:
      task - the lobby operation to run

    • submitToGame

      public void submitToGame(Executor command, VirtualView view)
      Routes a game command onto the queue of its own game, then executes it there resolving the acting player from the totem.
      Parameters:
      command - the game command; carries its own gameId and totem
      view - the sender's view, used to report routing errors

    • runGameCommand

      private void runGameCommand(GameSession session, Executor command)

    • closeGame

      public void closeGame(String gameId)
      Removes a game from the active map, shuts down its command queue and deletes its save file. Deliberately does NOT touch viewRegistry or the clients: views stay registered (and pinged) so players can linger on the end-game screen; their entries are cleaned up by disconnectPlayer when they leave.
      Parameters:
      gameId - the game to close

    • registerEndGameCleanup

      private void registerEndGameCleanup(GameController controller, String gameId)
      Registers the observer that closes the game when it reaches its terminal event. Must be registered AFTER the controller exists (so SaveObserver, added in the GameController constructor, performs its last save BEFORE this observer deletes the file — observers fire in registration order).
      Parameters:
      controller - the game controller
      gameId - game identifier

    • registerCountdown

      private void registerCountdown(GameController controller, String gameId)
      Registers the abandonment-countdown machinery for a game. The observer re-evaluates the timer on every connection change (disconnect/reconnect), always on the game's own queue. A freshly started game is warm; a game loaded from a save is cold until it reaches ≥2 connected.
      Parameters:
      controller - the game controller
      gameId - game identifier

    • reevaluateCountdown

      private void reevaluateCountdown(GameController controller, String gameId)
      Recomputes whether the abandonment timer should be armed. Runs on the game queue (invoked from the connection-change observer).

    • startCountdown

      private void startCountdown(GameController controller, String gameId, Player survivor)
      Arms a fresh countdown for the lone survivor: notifies their client and schedules the expiry. Cancels any previous timer first.

    • notifyCountdown

      private void notifyCountdown(String gameId, Player survivor)

    • onCountdownExpired

      private void onCountdownExpired(GameController controller, String gameId)
      Runs on the game queue when the countdown expires. Re-checks the connected set: a single survivor wins by abandonment; nobody connected closes the game; a resumed game (≥2) is a no-op.

    • cancelCountdown
